ground_truth_recall_audit.milestone: Dropped support for Python 3.8 and raised the minimum dependency versions to the latest feature releases
Added a configuration option to control whether Flask automatically answers OPTIONS requests
ground_truth_recall_audit.matching_narrative_excerpt: the commit on June 5, 2024 (SHA: d718ecf6) introduced a configuration option, `PROVIDE_AUTOMATIC_OPTIONS`, which allows developers to disable automatically generated OPTIONS responses.

ground_truth_recall_audit.milestone: Flask.open_resource, open_instance_resource and Blueprint.open_resource take an encoding parameter for text mode, defaulting to utf-8
Request.max_content_length can be customized per request instead of only through the MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH config, and new MAX_FORM_MEMORY_SIZE and MAX_FORM_PARTS configs were added
ground_truth_recall_audit.matching_narrative_excerpt: the commit on November 1, 2024 (SHA: c7a5388) introduced `MAX_FORM_MEMORY_SIZE` and `MAX_FORM_PARTS`, allowing developers to set limits on the size and number of form fields in multipart requests.

ground_truth_recall_audit.milestone: Added support for the Partitioned cookie attribute through the SESSION_COOKIE_PARTITIONED config
Changed .env loading so that `-e path` takes precedence over the default .env and .flaskenv files
Added secret key rotation with the SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS config
ground_truth_recall_audit.matching_narrative_excerpt: the commit on November 8, 2024 (SHA: e13373f) added support for `SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS`, enabling applications to maintain compatibility with older sessions while transitioning to new secret keys.

ground_truth_recall_audit.milestone: Fixed how host_matching=True and subdomain_matching=False interact with SERVER_NAME
ground_truth_recall_audit.matching_narrative_excerpt: the fix for `subdomain_matching=False` behavior (commit on November 11, 2024, SHA: 4995a775) addressed how the `SERVER_NAME` configuration interacts with request handling.
